title: CraftSquad Configuration Schema
description: Schema for CraftSquad Multi-Engine Multi-Agent Squad configuration

$schema.description: Link to the JSON schema file

defaultReasoningEffort.description: Default reasoning effort for non-Gemini roles (Codex, Claude)

geminiDefaultReasoningEffort.description: Default reasoning effort for Gemini roles (Gemini 3.8 Flash)

roles.description: Squad role definitions and model/engine bindings

scrum_master.description: Sofia - BMAD Product Owner & Lead Scrum Master (PRD breakdown, User Stories, Sprints)

architect.description: Winston - BMAD System & DB Architect (Deep architecture, database schema, data contracts)

ui_designer.description: Sally - BMAD Lead UX/UI Designer (Presentational UI skeletons, design tokens)

developer.description: Amelia - BMAD Senior Full-Stack Developer (Business logic, endpoints, transactions, state wiring)

code_reviewer.description: Oliver - BMAD Adversarial Reviewer (Independent adversarial audit of code diffs)

tester.description: QA Test Engineer (Unit tests, integration tests, test vectors)

qa_gatekeeper.description: Deterministic Gatekeeper (Compiler, linter, tests, and build runner with exit code 0)

model.description: Model ID used by the engine (e.g. gpt-6.1-sol, claude-3-7-sonnet-latest, gemini-3.8-flash)

persona.description: BMAD persona name and role title

command.description: Deterministic CLI command when engine is 'cli'
